text:
First trip to Okinawa and wondering about a rental car? In Naha you don't need one: the monorail gets you from the airport to Kokusai-dori in 13 to 16 minutes for ¥290 to ¥320. The car question only starts when you head north 👇

🤔 Kokusai-dori, Asahibashi or Omoromachi: guess which one we'd pick, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/naha-where-to-stay-do-you-need-a-car

We checked the monorail's own fare tables and the aquarium's access page for this one.

🏮 KOKUSAI-DORI (our pick)

Prefectural Office or Makishi station. Covered side streets lead to the Makishi Public Market, and Shuri Castle is 11 minutes from Makishi. Ask for a room off the main street, which stays lively at night.

🚌 ASAHIBASHI

The closest stop to the airport, 11 minutes and ¥290, with Naha Bus Terminal next to the station. Good if most of your days are bus trips north.

🛍️ OMOROMACHI

Newer and calmer, with T Galleria by DFS by exit 1. Easy with kids, and Makishi is only 3 minutes away.

🚗 AND THE CAR?

The official Churaumi Aquarium site says about two hours from the airport by car, against about three by express bus. So we'd skip the car in Naha and rent one only for the days you go north.

🎫 PASS OR NOT?

The 1-day ticket is ¥1,000 and runs 24 hours from purchase, not by calendar day. Buy it on arrival in the afternoon and it still covers the next morning.
